text: answer[inference-attest-68ed6df4]: To verify a model inference output signature, the inference runtime signs a hash of the output along with metadata such as the model identifier, timestamp, and input digest using an asymmetric private key. A verifier later checks the signature against the corresponding public key to confirm the output was produced by the authentic model and has not been altered. This provides tamper-evidence for ML inference pipelines, useful in regulated environments where downstream consumers must prove a result originated from a specific model version and was not modified in transit.
